summary: TXO Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the Cross Timbers Transactions, the sale of substantially all assets held by its 50%-owned joint venture, Cross Timbers Energy, LLC, to multiple private buyers for aggregate consideration of approximately $200 million. The largest component was the CTOC Transaction with CTOC Energy, LLC (an entity owned by family members of Chairman Bob R. Simpson), valued at approximately $123.5 million. The Board and Conflicts Committee (independent directors) unanimously approved the deal. Net proceeds to TXO were approximately $100 million, to be used to pay down credit facility debt. No break fee or premium was stated. The closing date was May 28, 2026. Watch for any related-party scrutiny and debt reduction impact.
